title: Mr. Loppit
html:
Mr. Loppit
Piece:  Weapon
Type:  Two-handed Axe
Class:  Fighter
Damage:  varies with item level

Mr. Loppit is a fighter two-handed axe.

This item is soulbound.

Attributes:

The name and the look are fixed. The joke ending is one of the weapon suffixes. That ending is what sets the primaries.

The rest of the stats roll and do not show up in the name.

  • Stun: enemy stun chance, stun resistance, or both. Random.
  • Rating: attack rating, defense rating, or both. Random.
  • Resists: a random pair or triple from divine, fire, ice, poison, and shadow.
  • Crit: crit chance or crit damage. Random.

It is unknown how many different varieties exist. The same ending can still drop with different rolls underneath.
